description: Assistant Beauticians provide a wide range of services that include the care of the hair, skin and nails. A beautician primary focus is on improving their client outward appearance and helping them to feel better about themselves in general.
awardingBodyName: West Bengal State Council of Technical and Vocational Education and Skill Development
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Fresh Skilling

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Carry out hair treatment for common hair problems. Illustrateand explain structure of hair.
Create basic haircuts using special cutting techniques.
Able to work in real job situation with special emphasis on basic safety and hazards in this domain.
Plan to set up a small business related to beauty related services.
Prepare mehndi paste, make cones and create simple Indian and Arabic designs with care and workplace cleanliness.
Demonstrate day, evening, party, basic makeup and explain effects of light on makeup.
Carry out facial services using different facial packs.
Carry out temporary removal of Superfluous hair, Threading,Tweezing and Bleaching.
Perform basic manicure and pedicure services.
Prepare work area and assist in client consultation.

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.PREVNSQFLEVELSACHIEVED: Previous relevant qualification of NSQF Level 2.5
